title: Paloma Rewards Points Expiry and Forfeiture
content:
Paloma Rewards points earned in a calendar month expire at the end of the month that is the tier's points-expiry number of months later, oldest points being used first by redemptions.

## Clauses

1. **Monthly expiry.** Points earned in a calendar month expire together at the end of the month that lies the points-expiry number of months after the month of earning. Redemptions use the oldest points first.
2. **Inactivity.** Every remaining point expires when no qualifying transfer has completed for the tier's inactivity number of months, counted from the most recent qualifying transfer date shown on the membership.
3. **Opt-out.** On an opt-out every remaining point is forfeited when the tier's opt-out forfeiture term is on.
4. **Termination.** On a termination every remaining point is forfeited.
5. **No restoration.** Expired or forfeited points are never restored, except that points expired in error are re-credited as goodwill.
6. **Which tier.** Expiry follows the tier in force on the expiry date.

Each lapse appears in the points history with its reason and the month the lapsing points were earned; for a forfeiture on opt-out or termination, the month shown is the month of closure.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

**Oldest first.** A member holds 200 points earned in January and 300 earned in February, and redeems 400 points. The redemption uses all 200 January points and 200 of the February points; 100 February points remain and expire with the February batch.

**End-of-month expiry.** With a points-expiry period of 12 months, points earned on any day of March 2026 expire at the end of March 2027. With 18 months they would expire at the end of September 2027.

## Points of judgement

| Event | Effect on remaining points |
|---|---|
| End of the expiry month of a monthly batch | That batch's remaining points expire |
| No qualifying transfer for the inactivity period, counted from the most recent qualifying transfer date | Every remaining point expires |
| Opt-out, opt-out forfeiture term on | Every remaining point is forfeited |
| Termination | Every remaining point is forfeited |
| Points shown to have expired in error | Re-credited as goodwill |
| Any other expiry or forfeiture | Never restored |
